To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the rating assessment of academic workers of institutions of higher learning is the most effective way to motivate employees to professional development and to optimize labour costs.

the development of professional career is a complex and multifaceted process that requires a systematic and comprehensive approach to the development and introduction of an effective organizational and economic system of optimizing labour costs.

the introduction of a new method of rating assessment of the work of scientific and pedagogic workers in the system of higher education in general, will contribute to the development of the intellectual potential of higher education institutions, and, as a result, will increase the competitiveness of higher education institutions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the methodical approach to the rating assessment of employees of higher education institutions as a part of career development.

the improvement of the system for the development of professional career of employees of higher education institutions, which is based on the rating assessment of employees and the use of the results of such an assessment as an indicator of the need to optimize labour costs and to develop professional career development.
the improvement of the methodical approach to rating evaluation of employees as a means of professional career development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the rating assessment of employees of higher education institutions should be based on the results of the implementation of the development strategy of the institution, which is the result of the activities of the management team and academic workers.

the development and introduction of an effective organizational and economic system of optimizing labour costs, including the use of a rating assessment, is an effective tool for the development of professional career of employees of higher education institutions.

the development and implementation of a system of rating performance appraisal for academic workers of higher education as part of their professional development is an effective tool for improving the quality of educational services and optimizing labour costs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development of a system to optimize the use of labour resources and career development of academic workers of universities should be carried out in a comprehensive manner, taking into account all the factors of the functioning of higher education institutions.

the development of professional career of academic workers of educational institutions should be based on a system of rating assessment of their activities, which should take into account not only the quantitative but also qualitative indicators of their work.

the development of professional career of employees of higher education institutions, which is based on the results of rating assessment of activities of employees, should be carried out in the following sequence: development of a rating assessment system of activities of academic workers of institutions of higher learning; development of the system of planning professional career development of employees; development of a system to monitor the effectiveness of the system of professional career development of academic workers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the introduction of a method of assessing the activities of scientific and pedagogic workers of higher education in the context of career development will allow to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of higher education institutions, to increase the competitiveness of higher education institutions.

the introduction of a system of rating assessment of the performance of academic workers and their career development will allow to optimize the costs of higher education institutions, which will contribute to the development of the educational sector of the economy and will be an effective mechanism for the formation of the intellectual potential of the state.

the development of the rating method for assessing employees and the development of professional career of personnel should be based on the principles of the market economy, which will ensure the competitiveness of higher education institutions, the development of the educational sector, and the country's economy in general.
